description: This file contains functional tests for the OrderController's index action, specifically testing the behavior when an anonymous user tries to access the 'my-orders' page. It uses Xunit for testing and WebApplicationFactory to create a test server client.

classes.name: OrderIndexOnGet
classes.description: A test class that verifies the behavior of the order listing page for anonymous users, ensuring proper redirect to login.
